sections.title: Phrase
sections.info:
How each key's melody (its motif) is made. Every key gets its own motif: a random walk over the scale with a Euclidean rhythm, 16 steps long, ending on the root, fifth or octave.

Scale, Chaos, Density, Gravity, At or above key and Motif set are read when you press a key, so a change is heard from the next key you play. Mutations and Drift apply from the next pass.

sections.title: Pattern
sections.info: What a held key does with its motif over time. A pass is 16 steps (one bar at 1/16), locked to the tempo: the DAW's in a plugin, the tempo control here in the browser.

sections.title: Voice
sections.info: The tone of every note, the key's own and the ghosts: a two-operator FM voice.

sections.title: Main note envelope
sections.info:
Shapes the note of the key you play. It also shapes the tone: brightness swells during the attack, settles with the decay and dulls on release.

Velocity sets the note's loudness, so the envelope's own velocity amount starts at zero.

sections.title: Ghosts
sections.info: The generated notes. They play on MIDI channel 16 and go through a band-pass filter tuned to each note's own pitch, so they sit behind the main note like overtones. How hard you play the key sets how loud its ghosts are.

sections.title: Ghost envelope
sections.info: Shapes every ghost note, and its tone the same way the main envelope does. Long attacks blur the phrase into a pad; short ones make it pluck.

sections.title: Echo
sections.info: A mono echo after everything, darkened on each repeat, followed by a gentle compressor that glues the notes and echoes together. The time is in seconds, not locked to the tempo.

Add as many LFOs as the sound needs (up to 8) with Add LFO, and remove them with ×; each preset keeps its own. An LFO does nothing until it's routed: right-click a knob and choose Modulate…, or add a route in the matrix below.

Sync locks an LFO to the tempo. Per Voice restarts it with each note, ghosts included, so every ghost gets its own wobble; Global shares one for all.

Each route sends a source (an LFO, an envelope, velocity, the mod wheel, the beat…) to a parameter, by an amount; 'via' scales it by a second source.

Routes reach Brightness, Vibrato, the ghost Level, Band-pass, Q and Legato, the Echo, the kit's Pitch and Level, and the LFOs themselves. The Phrase settings can't be modulated, so a motif set always plays the same phrases.

paramInfo.phrase.scale: The notes motifs are built from. A new scale gives every key a new motif.
paramInfo.phrase.chaos: How far a motif strays from neat. More chaos drops beats from the Euclidean rhythm, adds notes off the grid, and allows leaps of several scale steps instead of small steps.
paramInfo.phrase.density: How many of the 16 steps have a note: from 3 at 0% to 11 at 100%, spread as evenly as possible (a Euclidean rhythm). Each key's rhythm is rotated differently.
paramInfo.phrase.gravity: How strongly the melody is pulled back toward the key you're holding. Low gravity lets it wander up and down the range; high keeps it circling the key.
paramInfo.phrase.mutations: How many notes change on each pass: each moves a scale step or two. The first time a key's motif is heard it plays as made. The first and last notes never change, so the phrase stays recognisable.
paramInfo.phrase.above: On: ghosts play from the key up to three octaves above. Off: they can also go an octave below it.
paramInfo.phrase.drift: Off: each pass mutates the original motif, so the phrase wobbles around it. On: each pass mutates the last one, so changes build up and the phrase wanders away. A key remembers where it drifted to until its motif changes.
paramInfo.phrase.set: Which collection of motifs the keys use. The same set (with the same Phrase settings) always gives the same phrases, so a project reopens sounding the same. Try another number for new phrases.
paramInfo.pattern.mode:
Play to end: the pattern plays all its repeats even after you let go.
Stop on release: letting go stops new ghosts; sounding ones ring out.
Loop while held: the pattern keeps repeating (and mutating) for as long as you hold the key.
paramInfo.pattern.repeats: How many passes a pattern plays in Play to end and Stop on release. Ignored by Loop while held.
paramInfo.pattern.rate: The length of one step, as a note value at the current tempo. A pass is 16 steps.
paramInfo.voice.brightness: How much the FM modulator bends the tone: low is near a pure sine, high is bright and bell-like. Playing harder makes notes brighter too. MIDI CC 74 moves it.
paramInfo.voice.vibrato: Vibrato depth in cents. Each note gets its own slightly different speed, and the vibrato fades in over the attack plus about half a second.
paramInfo.ghost.level: How loud the ghosts are against the main note. They also follow how hard you played the key.
paramInfo.ghost.filter: Turns the ghosts' band-pass filter on or off.
paramInfo.ghost.bp: How much of each ghost goes through its band-pass: 0 is the plain FM tone, 1 only the filtered sound (softer, rounder). MIDI CC 71 moves it.
paramInfo.ghost.q: How narrow the band-pass is. Higher Q keeps less of the sound around each ghost's own pitch, for a purer, whistling tone.
paramInfo.ghost.stages: One filter stage, or two in a row for a steeper, purer band-pass.
paramInfo.ghost.legato: How long each ghost lasts, as a share of the time until the next one: low is staccato, 100% joins them up.
paramInfo.ghost.only: Silences the note of the key you play, so only its ghosts sound; the first ghost then plays on the key's downbeat.
paramInfo.echo.mix: How much of the sound goes into the echo.
paramInfo.echo.time: Time between repeats, in seconds. Modulating it slightly with a slow LFO bends the echoes' pitch, like tape.
paramInfo.echo.feedback: How much of each repeat comes back again: more feedback, longer tails.
paramInfo.lfo1.mode: Global: one LFO shared by every note. Per Voice: it restarts with each note, ghosts included, so each ghost gets its own wobble.
paramInfo.lfo1.fade: The LFO fades in over this time after each note starts, like a player easing into vibrato. With a fade, every note gets its own copy of the LFO.
paramInfo.lfo1.phase: Shifts where in its cycle the LFO is: the point it starts from in Per Voice mode, an offset in Global.

paramInfo.env1.velocity: How much playing harder makes the envelope louder. Aleatory already sets the main note's loudness from velocity, so 0 is the usual setting; raise it for a steeper response.
paramInfo.env2.velocity: How much playing harder makes the envelope louder. Aleatory already sets the ghosts' loudness from velocity, so 0 is the usual setting; raise it for a steeper response.
paramInfo.sk.a4: Concert pitch: the frequency of the A above middle C.
